articles.title: ‘The Simpsons’ celebrates 800 episodes: 10 times the cartoon predicted the future
articles.summary: The long-running animated series The Simpsons, across 37 seasons and nearly 800 episodes, continues to astound viewers with its uncanny ability to predict the future. Jokes and gags from the show frequently manifest into real-world events, making its prophetic nature a surprising and much-discussed aspect of its enduring legacy.

articles.title: Analysis-Risk of missteps hangs over US-backed ceasefire deal in northeast Syria
articles.summary: A U.S.-backed ceasefire in northeastern Syria leaves critical questions unresolved regarding the region's future. Syrian Kurds, despite their significantly weakened position following recent developments, are still striving to retain some level of authority. Their ability to maintain autonomy and the overall stability of the region remain uncertain, posing ongoing challenges for international diplomacy and security.

articles.title: Shillong to host 10-day Assam Rifles Sentinels Cup Tournament
articles.summary: The fourth edition of the Assam Rifles Sentinels Cup, a significant football tournament, is scheduled from February 17 to 27, 2026, across multiple venues in Shillong. This event highlights the Assam Rifles' commitment to youth engagement and sports promotion in the region. For SSB aspirants, it exemplifies the defence forces' broader role in community building and national integration through such impactful initiatives.

articles.title: White Knight Corps GOC reviews operational preparedness of troops in Pallanwala sector
articles.summary: Lieutenant General P K Mishra, GOC White Knight Corps, recently visited forward areas along the Line of Control in Jammu and Kashmir's Pallanwala sector. This inspection likely aimed to review operational preparedness, assess the prevailing security situation, and interact with troops deployed in sensitive border regions. Such high-level visits are crucial for maintaining readiness and morale among frontline forces guarding India's borders.

articles.title: Pentagon to move carrier to Middle East from Caribbean, officials say
articles.summary: The Pentagon is deploying an aircraft carrier from the Caribbean to the Middle East, a move that will position two U.S. carriers in the region. This significant reinforcement, reported on Feb 13, aims to bolster American naval presence and strategic capabilities in the critical Middle East theater. It underscores an enhanced U.S. military posture amidst evolving regional dynamics.

articles.title: YouTube Executive Says IRON LUNG Box Office Hit is Both “Scary” And “Fruitful For The Industry”
articles.summary: YouTube megastar Markiplier's sci-fi horror film, "Iron Lung," is bridging the gap between digital creators and traditional Hollywood. This signifies a major shift in the entertainment industry, showcasing the growing influence and production capabilities of online personalities. It highlights new avenues for content creation and distribution, making it a relevant trend in media and technology.

articles.title: This Uninell vacuum I found on Amazon lets me live my Dyson dreams on the cheap
articles.summary: The article discusses a consumer's decision to purchase a budget-friendly cordless vacuum, a 'Dyson dupe,' during Amazon Prime Big Deal Days. Unable to afford a high-end Dyson, the individual explored cheaper alternatives and took a chance on an affordable model. This highlights consumer trends in seeking value and accessible technology within the home appliance market.
